# OctoProbe AI

> Every OSINT tool. One investigation graph. OctoProbe AI is an OSINT investigation platform for law firms, licensed investigators, OSINT analysts, and opposition research teams.

Start with one clue — an email, phone number, handle, name, domain, or photo. OctoProbe runs it through 20+ premium APIs, public records, and facial recognition at once, then maps every connection on one live investigation graph, with the evidence attached.

## Key capabilities

- **Expansion layers**: every identifier opens its own layer of leads, with suggestions for the next lead worth chasing
- **Premium APIs, built in**: breach intelligence, account discovery, phone intelligence, and digital infrastructure
- **Public records**: court filings, corporate records, and financial disclosures
- **Facial recognition**: turn profile photos and uploads into open-web matches, reviewed by an analyst
- **Live link graph**: watch the network build in real time; click any link to see why it's there
- **Analyst case file**: matters, tasks, hypotheses, watches, and alerts alongside the graph
- **Evidence collection**: every finding captured with its source and timestamp; web pages preserved
- **Reports & sharing**: polished, sourced reports and secure guest sharing
- **MCP server**: connect any MCP-compatible client to the whole toolkit

## Who uses OctoProbe

- Law firms: asset discovery, witness and adverse-party backgrounds, skip trace
- Licensed private investigators: locate, identity intelligence, alias resolution
- OSINT analysts: account mapping, breach correlation, infrastructure pivots
- Opposition research and corporate intelligence: donor networks, financial disclosures, corporate ownership

## Notes

OctoProbe is not a consumer reporting agency; results may not be used for FCRA-covered eligibility decisions.
